description: A skill withheld at declaration because it names a tool the host did not declare (ADR-0009): declaration names write_file, which hostTools (the host's declared tools, a tool with a source by its wire name) does not hold. A skill names the host's declared tools only and grants none, so it is not catalogued and nothing of it reaches the model; its digest is the pinned one, so the tool alone withholds it. The guardrail, before any request, names the skill and the tool; its reason is skill withheld. Written by hand; skills.test.ts and go/context hold declareSkills to it.

declaration.name: file_helper
declaration.description: Save the drafted pack to a file.
declaration.instructions: When the pack is drafted, call write_file with its text.

items.detail: the skill file_helper names the tool "write_file", which the host did not declare for this run; the skill is not offered, and a skill grants no tool
